title: Trade Alpha Attribution - Order Efficiency Report

counting_contract.broker_order_statement: Neither 645 nor 190 is a verified broker-order count. 645 is internal sleeve fills; 190 is a closer nettable-action proxy.

direct_costs.interpretation: Cash friction is material but does not explain the AB5 return gap; AB5 ON explicit fees are slightly lower than OFF, so exposure-path opportunity cost dominates.

order_event_diagnostics.note: These are decision events, not executed broker orders.

low_value_candidate_definition: same symbol is reduced/exited and then re-entered shortly afterwards
the longer-term trend remains intact after the exit
the action is driven by non-catastrophic budget/position adjustment rather than hard risk
a future preregistered counterfactual can remove or consolidate the action without materially worsening drawdown, tail risk or account continuity
preserve: stops proven to avoid catastrophic loss
decision: Reduce evidence-proven low-value churn, not the transaction count as an end in itself.
